// diagnostic E0780

Jet.RetryReachesUnkeyedIrreversible

Retried job `{fn_name}` reaches irreversible `{callee}` without `#Repeatable`, an idempotency key, or `at_least_once: true`

What

Retried job `{fn_name}` reaches irreversible `{callee}` without `#Repeatable`, an idempotency key, or `at_least_once: true`

Why

When a retried job fails and runs again, an irreversible call that is neither repeatable nor keyed will run more than once and leave duplicate external side effects

Fix

Wrap the call in a `#Repeatable(key: ...)` operation, defer it with `app.enqueue`, set `retries: 0`, or mark the job `#App.Job(at_least_once: true)` if duplicate delivery is acceptable
